e.title: **把一个**派生统计量**做成一整套工具：**「**每个回答都带来源与许可**」****：npm 包与 MCP 注册处记录 `@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`（**2026-09-06 发布，**两个版本相隔约 50 分钟**）——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**；**⭐ 七个工具里有**一个专门叫 `dataset_provenance`****（**来源、**计算日期、**许可与引用**）**；**⭐ 而**登记处的描述**被截断****（**npm 上才是完整句**：**NFIP **2023–2026**）；**⚠️ 而其 `repository` 字段**实测 **404****
e.title_en: A single derived statistic published as a full set of agent tools, where every answer is stated to carry its source and licence, with one of the seven tools dedicated to provenance and citation, registered both as a package and as a registry entry published within about fifty minutes of each other and naming a repository that returns not found.
e.title_hk: **把一個**派生統計量**做成一整套工具：**「**每個回答都帶來源與許可**」****：npm 包與 MCP 註冊處記錄 `@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`（**2026-09-06 發布，**兩個版本相隔約 50 分鐘**）——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**；**⭐ 七個工具裡有一個專門叫 `dataset_provenance`****；**⭐ 而**登記處的描述被截斷****（**npm 上才是完整句**）；**⚠️ 而其 `repository` 欄位實測 404****
e.summary: **damagerestore-claims-index**（npm 包与 MCP 注册处 `com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`）**是把**一个派生统计量**（**水损理赔的已付中位数**）**做成一整套 Agent 工具的做法****——**逐字自述为**「**An MCP server over a real, sourced dataset.**」**，**并逐字写明交付方式**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**。**本次实测**：**npm 包 **`@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`** 许可 **MIT****、**创建 **2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z**、**两个版本**（`0.1.0` 与 `1.0.0`，**相隔约 **50 分钟****）**、**依赖 **`@ellul-estate/mcp-kit`****、**包体仅 **1,643 字节、**4 个文件**（**其中入口 `bin.mjs` **638 字节****）**；**注册处同一天给出两条记录**（**`0.1.0` 与 `1.0.0`）**，**而**其中一条的 `repository` 字段**实测指向一个 **404** 的仓库**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **七个工具里有一个专做**来源与引用****（`dataset_provenance`）**；**② **逐字承诺**每个回答都带来源与许可**；**③ **完整数据集**同时作为 MCP **resource** 提供**；**④ **登记处描述被截断、**而 npm 上是完整句**——**⭐ 即**同一条目在两个登记处**信息量不同**。**⚠️ 本次**未执行该包的入口、**未调用任何数据集工具**。
e.summary_hk: **damagerestore-claims-index**（npm 包與 MCP 註冊處 `com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`）**是把**一個派生統計量**（**水損理賠的已付中位數**）**做成一整套 Agent 工具的做法****——**逐字自述為**「**An MCP server over a real, sourced dataset.**」**，**並逐字寫明交付方式**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**。**本次實測**：**npm 包許可 MIT**、**建立 2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 2026-09-06T17:54:29Z**、**兩個版本（`0.1.0` 與 `1.0.0`，相隔約 50 分鐘）**、**依賴 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit`****、**包體僅 1,643 位元組、**4 個檔案（**入口 `bin.mjs` 638 位元組****）**；**註冊處同日給出兩條記錄**，**而**其中一條的 `repository` 欄位**實測指向一個 **404** 的倉庫**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **七個工具裡有一個專做**來源與引用****；**② **逐字承諾**每個回答都帶來源與許可**；**③ **完整資料集**同時作為 MCP resource 提供**；**④ **登記處描述被截斷、**npm 上是完整句****。**⚠️ 本次**未執行該包入口、**未調用任何資料集工具**。
e.summary_en: The npm package and registry entry damagerestore-claims-index **turn one derived statistic, the median paid water damage claim, into a full set of agent tools**, described verbatim as an MCP server over a real sourced dataset and as served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer. **Measured this round**: the package is licensed MIT, was created and modified within about fifty minutes on the same day in September, carries two versions, depends on a shared toolkit package, and is only about one point six kilobytes with four files, of which the entry point is six hundred and thirty-eight bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: one of the seven tools is dedicated to provenance, source, computed date, licence and citation; the package promises verbatim that every answer carries its source and licence; the full dataset is also offered as a resource; and the registry description is truncated while the package description carries the complete sentence, so the same item holds different amounts of information in two registries**. **The package entry point was not executed this round and no dataset tool was called.**
e.body:
**damagerestore-claims-index**（npm 包 **`@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`** 与 MCP 注册处 **`com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`**）**是把**一个派生统计量**做成一整套 Agent 工具的做法****——**逐字自述为**「**An MCP server over a real, sourced dataset.**」**，**并逐字写明交付方式**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**，**其主题逐字为**「**DamageRestore HQ: the median paid water damage claim, read from NFIP claim records (2023 to 2026)**」**。**本次实测**：**npm 许可 **MIT****、**创建 **2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z**、**两个版本**（`0.1.0` 与 `1.0.0`**）**、**包体 **1,643 字节 / 4 个文件****（**`package.json`／**`server.json`／**`README.md`／**`bin.mjs` 638 字节**）**、**维护者逐字为 **`ellul-estate`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据与 npm registry 元数据与包内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七个工具里有一个**专做来源与引用****——**包内 README 逐字列出七个工具及其回答什么**：`dataset_columns`（**模式：列、**哪些是数值、**行数与**出处**）、`dataset_search`、`dataset_row`、`dataset_compare`、`dataset_stats`、`dataset_top`，**以及** `dataset_provenance`（**逐字**「**the source, computed date, licence and citation**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**它把「**这份数据是哪来的、**什么时候算的、**许可是什么、**该怎么引用**」**做成**一个可调用的工具**——**⭐ 这与本站第 339 轮「**每个值指回它的来源**」、第 354 轮「**可引用性**」同向**，**而**这里是**把可引用性当成一个工具接口**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**每个回答都带来源与许可**」是逐字承诺**——**逐字**：**「**The full dataset is also offered as a CSV resource.**」**与**「**Source: FEMA. **Every answer carries the dataset page and licence.** The data is free to cite with a link to https://damagerestorehq.com/data.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得抄**：**⭐ 即**不是「**请注明来源**」**这种**对外要求**，**而是**「**我给出去的每个回答**自带来源与许可**」**这种**对内约束**——**⭐ 与之对照**：**多数数据服务**把引用要求**写在条款里**，**而**不**放在**每次返回**里**。**⭐⭐ ③ 交付形态被拆成**包 ＋ 注册处 ＋ 数据页三处****——**实测**：**npm 包为 **stdio 传输**（**入口 `bin.mjs`**，**依赖 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit`**）**，**安装方式逐字为** `npx @ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`**；**注册处同日给出**两条记录**（`0.1.0` 与** `1.0.0`**）**，**其中一条的** `packages` **字段指向同一个 npm 包**；**而**数据本身另在**网站页** `https://damagerestorehq.com/data` **发布**，**许可条款另在** `https://damagerestorehq.com/terms`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一个东西**在**三个地方**各有形态**（**可安装的包、**可发现的注册处条目、**给人看的数据页**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 同一条目在两个登记处**信息量不同**（本次实测）**——**注册处的描述**被截断**，**逐字止于**「**read from NFIP claim records (2023 to**」**——**逐字續**「****」**；**而** npm 上的**同句完整**，**逐字为**「**read from NFIP claim records (**2023 to 2026**)**」**。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列两处**，**并指出**：**⭐ 即**登记处的**截断**会让**读者**看不到**最关键的时间范围**——**⭐ 这与第 361 轮前两条**（**登记处一句话、**真实内容更多**）是同一类落差**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本与发布节奏可核**——**npm 元数据实测**：**创建 **2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z****（**约 **50 分钟**内**从 `0.1.0` **到** `1.0.0`**）**，**两版**均带**完整性哈希**（**v1.0.0 为 **sha512**）**，**而**注册处**两条记录的**发布时间同为 **2026-09-06****；**⭐ 本词条认为**「**首版到正式版相隔 50 分钟**」**本身是一条信息**：**⭐ 即**这是一个**当天成形的发布**，**而**不是**长期维护的包**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**登记处字段与现实不符**（本次实测）**——**注册处 `1.0.0` 记录的** `repository` 字段逐字为** `https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**，**npm 元数据里 **v1.0.0 的** `repository` 亦逐字为** `git+https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate.git`**；**而**该地址**实测返回 **404****（**仓库页与原始文件均不可得**）**。**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**，**并指出**这与**同族的两个询价服务**（**见上一条**）**指向**同一个 404 地址**——**⭐ 即**这三条记录**共用**一个**不可访问的仓库字段**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、**[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、**[[rfema]] 覆盖美国国家洪水保险计划（**NFIP）数据与工具**，**[[claims-api]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 覆盖理赔与证据**，**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[us-mortgage-financing-constants]] 覆盖「**每个值自带来源**」的常数数据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个派生统计量配七个工具：**其中一个是**来源与引用工具** ＋ **逐字承诺每个回答自带来源与许可 ＋ **完整数据另作 resource 提供**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 把「**来源、**计算日期、**许可与引用**」**做成一个工具**，**而不是**一句条款**；**② **让每次返回**自带来源与许可**；**③ **完整数据**可另作 **resource** 提供**；**④ **同一个东西在多个登记处时**要检查描述是否被截断**；**⑤ **发布节奏**（**首版到正式版相隔多久**）**可以当作成熟度线索**。

**⚠️ 本条目如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有执行该 npm 包的入口、**也没有调用任何数据集工具**（**未取任何水损理赔数字、**未跑 `npx`、**未连任何 MCP 客户端**），**故**不主张**其数据、**统计或**「**每次返回都带来源**」这一承诺的实际行为**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未读包内 `bin.mjs` 的正文**（**⭐ 该文件仅 638 字节，**推测为**依赖 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit` 的薄封装**，**但**本词条**不作此判断**）**，**也未读** `server.json` **与** `package.json` **正文**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `dataset_provenance` **返回的来源字段**是否**真的包含计算日期与许可**（**⭐ 只读到 README 的表格**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**数据来源**是否确为** FEMA／**NFIP 记录**，**也未核实** 2023 至 2026 **这一范围**的**实际覆盖与更新频率**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**median paid water damage claim**」**这一指标的口径**（**⭐ 即**分母、**是否含税、**是否按年或按州**）**——**⚠️ 这对任何比较都关键**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**数据许可与 npm 的 **MIT 许可**是否**覆盖不同对象**（**⭐ README 把**数据许可指向网站条款页**，**而**包本身为 MIT**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**发布者**（`ellul-estate`／** `Ellul Solutions Ltd`）**与该网站的关系**，**也未核实其**是否**与被引用机构（**FEMA）**有任何关系**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 该包与注册处记录**均成于 **2026-09-06**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**——**⭐ 无需窗口例外说明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该指标是**衍生统计**，**不得**当作任何理赔、**定价或核保依据**。
e.body_hk:
**damagerestore-claims-index**（npm 包 **`@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`** 與 MCP 註冊處 **`com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`**）**是把**一個派生統計量**做成一整套 Agent 工具的做法****——**逐字自述為**「**An MCP server over a real, sourced dataset.**」**，**並逐字寫明交付方式**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**，**其主題逐字為**「**DamageRestore HQ: the median paid water damage claim, read from NFIP claim records (2023 to 2026)**」**。**本次實測**：**npm 許可 MIT**、**建立 2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 2026-09-06T17:54:29Z**、**兩個版本（`0.1.0` 與 `1.0.0`）**、**包體 1,643 位元組／4 個檔案**（**`bin.mjs` 638 位元組**）**、**維護者逐字為 `ellul-estate`****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。

**可核實資訊（均註冊處元資料、npm registry 元資料與包內檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七個工具裡有一個**專做來源與引用****——**README 逐字列出**：`dataset_columns`（**模式：列、**哪些是數值、**行數與出處**）、`dataset_search`、`dataset_row`、`dataset_compare`、`dataset_stats`、`dataset_top`、**以及** `dataset_provenance`（**逐字**「**the source, computed date, licence and citation**」**）**——**⭐ 即**把「**這份資料哪來的、**何時算的、**許可是什麼、**該怎麼引用**」**做成一個可調用工具**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**每個回答都帶來源與許可**」是逐字承諾**——**逐字**「**The full dataset is also offered as a CSV resource.**」**與**「**Source: FEMA. Every answer carries the dataset page and licence.**」**——**⭐ 即**不是對外要求「**請註明來源**」，**而是**對內約束「**我每次返回都自帶來源與許可**」。**⭐⭐ ③ 交付形態拆成三處**：**npm 包為 stdio 傳輸**（**入口 `bin.mjs`**、**依賴 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit`**、**逐字安裝方式** `npx @ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`**）**；**註冊處同日兩條記錄**；**資料另在** `https://damagerestorehq.com/data` **發布**，**條款在** `/terms`**——**⭐ 即**同一個東西在三個地方各有形態**。**⭐⭐ ④ 同**一條目在兩個登記處**資訊量不同**（本次實測）**：**註冊處描述被截斷**（**逐字止於** read from NFIP claim records (2023 to**」**——**逐字續**「****）**，**而** npm 上同句完整**（**逐字** 2023 to 2026**）**——**⭐ 即**截斷會讓讀者**看不到**最關鍵的時間範圍**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本與發布節奏可核**：**npm 建立 2026-09-06T17:04:32Z、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z****（**約 50 分鐘內**從 `0.1.0` 到 `1.0.0`**）**，**兩版**均帶**完整性雜湊**；**註冊處兩條記錄發布時間同為 2026-09-06**——**⭐ 即**這是一個**當天成形的發布****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一處**登記處欄位與現實不符**（本次實測）**：**註冊處 `1.0.0` 與** npm v1.0.0 的** `repository` 欄位**均逐字指向** `github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**，**而該位址**實測 404****——**⭐ 即**這條與同族兩個詢價服務**共用**一個**不可訪問的倉庫欄位**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、[[rfema]]、[[claims-api]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[insuranceoracle]]、[[property-hazard-mcp]]、[[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**一個派生統計量配七個工具：其中一個是來源與引用工具＋逐字承諾每個回答自帶來源與許可＋完整資料另作 resource 提供**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① 把「**來源、**計算日期、**許可與引用**」**做成工具**；**② **讓每次返回**自帶來源與許可**；**③ **完整資料**另作 resource 提供**；**④ **同一東西在多登記處時**要檢查描述是否被截斷**；**⑤ **發布節奏**可當成熟度線索**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有執行該 npm 包入口、**也未調用任何資料集工具**（**未取任何水損理賠數字、**未跑 `npx`、**未連 MCP 客戶端**），**不主張**其資料、**統計或「**每次返回都帶來源**」這一承諾的實際行為**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未讀包內 `bin.mjs` 正文**（**該檔僅 638 位元組**，**推測為薄封裝**，**但**本詞條不作此判斷**）**，**也未讀** `server.json` **與** `package.json` **正文**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `dataset_provenance` **返回的來源欄位**是否**真的含計算日期與許可**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其資料來源是否確為 **FEMA／**NFIP 記錄**，**未核實** 2023 至 2026 的**實際覆蓋與更新頻率**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**「**median paid water damage claim**」**的口徑**（**分母、**是否含稅、**是否按年或按州**）**——**⚠️ 這對任何比較都關鍵**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**資料許可與 npm **MIT 許可**是否**覆蓋不同對象**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者**與該網站的關係**，**未核實**其與被引用機構（**FEMA）**是否有任何關係**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**包與註冊處記錄均成於 2026-09-06（**窗口之內**）**，**無需窗口例外說明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該指標是**衍生統計**，**不得**當作任何理賠、**定價或核保依據**。
e.body_en:
The npm package and registry entry damagerestore-claims-index **turn one derived statistic, the median paid water damage claim read from national flood insurance claim records, into a full set of agent tools**, described verbatim as an MCP server over a real sourced dataset and as served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer. **Measured this round**: the package is licensed MIT, was created and modified within about fifty minutes on the same day in September, carries two versions, depends on a shared toolkit package, and is only about one point six kilobytes across four files, the entry point being six hundred and thirty-eight bytes; the maintainer name matches the operator named by the sibling enquiry servers described in the previous entry. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the package registry metadata and the package contents**: **first, one of seven tools is dedicated to provenance and citation**: the readme lists tools for the schema including which columns are numeric and the row count and provenance, for search, for row lookup, for comparison, for statistics over a numeric column, for the highest or lowest rows, and a provenance tool described verbatim as returning the source, computed date, licence and citation. **Turning where the data came from, when it was computed, what the licence is and how to cite it into a callable tool goes one step beyond writing provenance down, because the citation becomes part of the interface.** **Second, the promise that every answer carries source and licence is stated verbatim**: the full dataset is also offered as a comma-separated resource, the source is named as a federal agency, and every answer is stated to carry the dataset page and licence, with the data free to cite with a link. **This is an inward constraint rather than an outward request, where most data services put the citation requirement in terms and conditions rather than in each response.** **Third, the delivery is split across three places**: a package distributed for standard input and output transport with an install command and a shared toolkit dependency; two registry records published the same day; and the dataset itself published on a website page with a separate terms page. **One artefact in three forms is the same shape as a source appearing several ways.** **Fourth, the same item holds different amounts of information in two registries**: the registry description is truncated mid-sentence at the start of the year range while the package description carries the complete sentence naming the full range, **so truncation in a registry can hide the one detail a reader needs most**. **Fifth, versioning and publishing tempo are checkable**: the package was created and then modified about fifty minutes later, moving from an initial version to a first release, both carrying integrity hashes, with both registry records published the same day. **A first release arriving fifty minutes after the initial version is itself information: this is a same-day publication rather than a long-maintained package.** **Sixth, one registry field does not match reality, as measured here**: both the registry record and the package metadata name the same repository address, and that address was measured to return not found, **so this record shares an unreachable repository field with the two enquiry servers described in the previous entry**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover national flood insurance data and tooling, claims interfaces and evidence, agent-facing insurance services and a constants dataset in which every value carries its own source, **while this entry supplies a single derived statistic shipped with seven tools, one of which is a provenance and citation tool, a verbatim promise that every answer carries source and licence, and the full dataset offered separately as a resource. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled constants dataset and the pooled flood insurance tooling**; **five practices transfer directly: make source, computed date, licence and citation a callable tool rather than a clause; make every response carry its own source and licence; offer the full data as a separate resource; check whether a description has been truncated when the same item appears in several registries; and read publishing tempo as a maturity signal**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package entry point was not executed and no dataset tool was called** — no claim value retrieved, no command run and no MCP client connected — **so neither the data and statistics nor the actual behaviour of the promise that every answer carries its source is claimed**. **Second, the entry point and the two metadata files inside the package were not read**, the entry point being only six hundred and thirty-eight bytes and therefore presumed to be a thin wrapper over the shared toolkit, **a presumption this entry does not assert**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the provenance tool really returns a computed date and a licence was not verified**, only the readme table having been read. **Fourth, whether the source really is the national flood insurance claim records was not verified, nor was the actual coverage and update frequency behind the stated year range. Fifth, the definition of the headline metric was not verified** — its denominator, whether it is gross of tax, and whether it is annual or per state — **and that definition matters for any comparison**. **Sixth, whether the data licence and the package licence cover different things was not verified. Seventh, the relationship between the publisher and the website, and between the publisher and the federal agency credited as the source, were not verified. Eighth, on the window: both the package and the registry records date from 2026-09-06, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the metric is a derived statistic and must not be used as a basis for any claim, pricing or underwriting decision.**
